title: Vesper and the Vow
author: Coral Whitlock
blurb: Ansel Oyelaran, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
